subject.title: improve: reduce repeated session startup scans

question: Has the latest head addressed the member-requested streaming-reader, digest-cache, and benchmark concerns sufficiently to clear `CHANGES_REQUESTED` and `clawsweeper:human-review` after the PR body is refreshed?
rationale: The code evidence supports the narrow fix, but a member review and protected human-review label are explicit maintainer gates that automation should not override.

options.title: Clear after PR body refresh
options.body: Ask for or apply a PR-body refresh that removes the obsolete AGENTS.md cache claims and includes the latest transcript benchmark, then clear the review if the member agrees.

options.title: Request more benchmark proof
options.body: Keep the review blocked if the benchmark comment is not considered enough proof for the current head or if the evidence must live in the PR body before merge.

options.title: Hold for the broader issue
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want only a larger tail-reader design for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99190 rather than landing this narrow reset-guard mitigation.

recommendation.title: Clear after PR body refresh
recommendation.body: Ask for or apply a PR-body refresh that removes the obsolete AGENTS.md cache claims and includes the latest transcript benchmark, then clear the review if the member agrees.

likelyOwner.reason: hxy91819 made the blocking review request and is the clearest owner for deciding whether the revised code and benchmark evidence satisfy it.
